title: Two Paths
opening: Compare who decides and who supplies support across five dimensions. An arrangement can mix institutional and sovereign control.

labels.illustrationNote: This is an authored example, not a reported case. Actual terms decide who controls each part.
labels.mixedExample: A research partner supplies equipment, while the investigator chooses the question and may publish findings. If continued funding requires changing the question, that condition changes the arrangement.
labels.takeaway: Use the terms and actual decisions as evidence. Labels alone do not show who controls a choice.
labels.practiceHeading: Map an arrangement you are considering
labels.practiceIntro: Choose one real pursuit. For each dimension, describe who decides and who supplies what. Name mixed control where it exists; include the obligations and a practical way to continue if a dependency ends.
labels.permission: Permission: who authorizes the work and accepts responsibility?
labels.process: Process: who supplies or can change the method?
labels.resources: Resources: who allocates money, materials and support?
labels.container: Container: what setting or organization holds the work, and who can change it?
labels.capability: Capability: who supplies people, training and skills?
labels.continuation: What obligations attach, and how could the work continue if one dependency ended?
labels.privacy: This map is private to you. Saving it does not submit an assessment or mark the lesson complete.
labels.sourceQuote: The two paths begin with who decides. On the institutional path, an organization supplies a structure: authorization, process, resources, a place to work and needed capabilities. On the sovereign path, you decide and assemble those supports. A mixed arrangement can give you control of some parts while an institution supplies others.

dimensions.label: Permission
dimensions.institutional: Work is authorized by someone else's institution.
dimensions.sovereign: You authorize the pursuit and take responsibility for it.

dimensions.label: Process
dimensions.institutional: A process is supplied or prescribed.
dimensions.sovereign: You develop the process the situation requires.

dimensions.label: Resources
dimensions.institutional: The institution allocates money, materials or support.

dimensions.label: Container
dimensions.institutional: You work within an existing organization or setting.
dimensions.sovereign: You create or adapt the setting for the work.

dimensions.label: Capability
dimensions.institutional: The arrangement supplies people, training or skills.
dimensions.sovereign: You develop or assemble the capabilities needed.
